1_executive_email.body:
Dear Shunt OEM (Medtronic Technology Scouting / R&D Leadership,

I am writing to present a technology-transfer opportunity that may be of strategic interest to Shunt OEM (Medtronic.

## Technology
P-07 — Passive safety mechanism maintaining minimum drainage when primary paths 

## Why This May Matter to Shunt OEM (Medtronic, Integra)
Obstruction is the #1 shunt failure mode. A floor mechanism that maintains drainage under partial obstruction directly addresses the biggest clinical problem.

## Current Evidence
- Technical readiness: T1
- Physical validation: NONE
- Evidence is transparent and auditable — every claim traces to a source artifact

## What Is NOT Proven (Honest Disclosure)
- P-03 (related concept) falsified — floor too small, 0.001 mL/min/mmHg

## What We Are Asking
Commission the decisive experiment ($5-10K (ESTIMATED)) OR request technical diligence OR request co-development discussion. Licensing is a subsequent route after successful validation.

## Validation Investment
A defined experiment ($$5-10K, 6-12 months to T2) can upgrade this from T1 to externally verified status.

## Next Step
If this is of interest, I would welcome a 30-minute call to discuss:
1. Whether this fits your strategic roadmap
2. What evidence you would need to evaluate further
3. Whether a sponsored validation or co-development structure makes sense

I can share the full technical dossier under NDA.

Best regards,
[CEO Name]
CereVascular
